Title: Public Cloud Operations Lead
Location: Brampton, Ontario, Canada | Brampton, ON, Canada
Industry: Broadcast Media Production and Distribution, Book and Periodical Publishing, and Telecommunications
Description:
Our Technology team wakes up every day with one goal in mind - connecting Canadians to the people and things that matter most. Together, we are proud to support 30 million Canadians each month through managing a robust portfolio that champions leading-edge technology. We drive large-scale, complex, and high-visibility technology projects and programs that shape the future of technology in Canada and expand connectivity from coast to coast. If you are interested in being a part of this, consider applying for the following opportunity
  
  
**Who We're Looking For**
The Public Cloud Operations Lead is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for supporting and leading Public Cloud operations and Site Reliability Engineering (CloudSRE).
  
  
This is not a coordination-only role. The successful candidate is expected to remain actively involved in cloud troubleshooting, incident investigation, automation, observability, and technical problem solving while providing day-to-day technical leadership to the CloudSRE team and oversight of managed service providers.
  
  
The ideal candidate has a minimum of 4 years of relevant cloud, SRE, or infrastructure operations experience, previous experience as a Team Lead, Technical Lead, or equivalent, and strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure and AWS. Experience with GCP and OCI is considered an asset.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Technical Leadership
  
  

* Provide hands-on technical leadership to the CloudSRE team, remaining actively engaged in engineering, operational activities, and complex troubleshooting.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for cloud infrastructure, reliability, performance, availability, and major operational issues, leading root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Establish engineering standards and technical guardrails while mentoring engineers and strengthening the overall technical capability of the CloudSRE team.

Public Cloud Operations
  
  

* Provide hands-on administration, operations, and troubleshooting across Microsoft Azure and AWS, with experience in GCP and/or OCI considered an asset.
* Work across cloud technologies including networking, compute, storage, identity, RBAC/IAM, PaaS services, security, monitoring, backup/recovery, and high availability.
* Drive improvements in reliability, security, performance, operational efficiency, and cost, while supporting incident, problem, change, capacity, and availability management.

SRE & Observability
  
  

* Drive proactive monitoring and observability across infrastructure, platform, and application services using logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and service-health telemetry.
* Apply SRE practices including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, availability, capacity, incident, and problem management to improve service reliability and operational maturity.
* Improve alert quality, reduce noise, and use operational telemetry to proactively identify reliability, performance, capacity, and service-health risks, leveraging platforms such as Dynatrace, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, or equivalent.

Automation & Engineering
  
  

* Identify repetitive operational activities and automate them to reduce manual effort, operational risk, and human error using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Leverage Infrastructure as Code and DevOps practices using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* Promote an engineering-first approach to cloud operations, driving continuous improvement through automation, standardization, and reusable engineering solutions.

AI & AIOps
  
  

* Drive the practical adoption of AI-assisted operations and AIOps within the CloudSRE team, incorporating AI into day-to-day operational and engineering workflows.
* Apply AI-assisted capabilities to troubleshooting, incident investigation, log analysis, operational analysis, automation, and documentation to accelerate problem resolution.
* Identify and implement opportunities where AI agents, AI-assisted engineering tools, and AIOps platforms can reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, and enhance service reliability.

Incident & Problem Management
  
  

* Provide technical leadership during high-severity Public Cloud incidents, coordinating troubleshooting across CloudSRE, application teams, Cyber, infrastructure teams, vendors, and cloud service providers.
* Drive effective root-cause analysis and corrective/preventative actions, identifying recurring incidents and implementing engineering, automation, or monitoring solutions to prevent recurrence.
* Improve MTTD and MTTR through better observability, automation, runbooks, operational practices, and proactive problem management.

Vendor Management
  
  

* Provide technical oversight and direction to managed service providers and technology vendors, while maintaining internal technical ownership and accountability.
* Review vendor performance including technical deliverables, incident response, SLA adherence, engineering quality, and compliance with established cloud operational standards.
* Identify and address vendor capability or performance gaps, challenging technical solutions where appropriate and driving vendors toward sustainable engineering solutions and corrective actions.

Collaboration & Communication
  
  

* Collaborate closely with application teams, infrastructure, Cyber, engineering, service management, vendors, and cloud service providers to deliver reliable Public Cloud services.
* Translate complex technical issues into clear, actionable information for technical, non-technical, and leadership stakeholders, including risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.
* Provide clear technical direction and coordination during incidents, operational activities, and cross-functional initiatives.

**What You Bring**

* Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in Public Cloud engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, infrastructure operations, DevOps, or a related technical discipline.
* Previous experience as a Team Lead, Technical Lead, SRE Lead, Cloud Lead, or equivalent technical leadership role.
* Strong hands-on Microsoft Azure experience.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience.
* Strong cloud troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience with cloud networking, compute, storage, IAM/RBAC, monitoring, security, backup/recovery, and PaaS technologies.
* Demonstrated experience with observability and monitoring technologies and practices.
* Experience with automation and scripting, such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and/or DevOps automation.
* Experience with JIRA/Conflence
* Experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience leading or participating in high-severity incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
* Experience providing technical direction or oversight to third-party vendors or managed service providers.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with GCP and/or OCI.
* Experience with Dynatrace or comparable enterprise observability platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes and container platforms such as AKS, EKS, or GKE.
* Experience implementing SRE practices such as SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and service-health metrics.
* Experience with AI-assisted operations, AIOps, AI agents, or AI-enabled troubleshooting and automation.
* Relevant Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, Kubernetes, Terraform, DevOps, or SRE certifications are considered an asset.

**What Success Looks Like**

* The successful Public Cloud Operations Lead will
* Be a technical leader who remains hands-on, rather than operating solely as a coordinator or people manager.
* Be capable of independently troubleshooting complex Azure and AWS issues.
* Provide clear technical leadership during critical incidents.
* Improve reliability through better observability, automation, and SRE practices.
* Reduce manual operational effort through engineering and automation.
* Help the team adopt AI and AIOps as practical tools for day-to-day CloudSRE operations.
* Raise the technical capability of the broader CloudSRE team through mentoring and technical leadership.
* Hold vendors accountable for both service delivery and technical quality.
* Continually identify opportunities to improve the reliability, security, performance, efficiency, and cost effectiveness of Public Cloud services.

Title: Director, Network Development & Operations
Description:
**Xplore Inc. is Canada’s fibre, 5G and satellite broadband company for rural living. Xplore is committed to the relentless pursuit of an improved broadband experience for all Canadians. Xplore is building a world-class fibre optic and 5G wireless network to enable innovative broadband services for better every day rural living, for today and future generations.**
The Director, Network Development & Operations is the senior leader responsible for turning Xplore’s network architecture into an automated, scalable production network, delivering Core & Transport Network Services at a Tier-1 Telco Gold Standard and ensuring uncompromising reliability, security, and performance from the core to the customer. The role leads the teams accountable for detailed IP engineering, DWDM engineering automation, caching implementation, CI/CD, configuration management, telemetry, and operational tooling.
  
  
The Director sets the vision and operating model for network-as-code, ensuring that all IP/MPLS, DWDM, and caching configurations are deployed safely, consistently, and at scale. Under this leadership, the organization builds the automation frameworks, observability pipelines, and operational guardrails that enable high-velocity, low-risk changes across the backbone, reduce manual toil, and strengthen 24×7 operational readiness.
  
  
Working in close partnership with Network Architecture & Technology Strategy, the Director ensures that architectural intent is executed through modern DevOps practices, and brings operational insight back into standards, roadmaps, and long-term network evolution. The Director connects network development and operations directly to business outcomes and KPIs — including reliability, speed of change, customer experience, and cost efficiency — and serves as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on operational performance and automation maturity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**
Detailed IP, DWDM & Caching Engineering
  
  

* Own detailed IP engineering across BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, segment routing, and routing policy.
* Own DWDM configuration automation, including line-system configuration templates, channel provisioning, amplifier and span parameter automation, optical telemetry integration, and operational tooling for DWDM health and performance.
* Own caching platform implementation, including cache node configuration, routing and traffic-steering policies, cache peering and placement logic (as defined by Architecture), and performance tuning and hit-ratio optimization.
* Translate architectural standards into deployable configuration templates and network-as-code artifacts.

Network Automation & CI/CD Pipelines
  
  

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for IP/MPLS/DWDM and caching configuration deployment.
* Implement automated testing, validation, and rollback capabilities.
* Drive adoption of network-as-code across the Core & Transport domain, ensuring all changes are executed through automated, repeatable workflows.

Telemetry, Observability & Operational Tooling
  
  

* Own telemetry pipelines, dashboards, and observability tooling for Core & Transport.
* Ensure real-time visibility into routing behavior, caching performance and hit ratios, DWDM optical health (OSNR, span performance, and alarms), and capacity and traffic patterns.
* Partner with Service Assurance & Observability to integrate signals, alerts, anomaly detection, and automated diagnostics.

Reliability Engineering & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Implement guardrails, automated checks, and configuration validation to reduce operational risk.
* Lead post-incident automation improvements to prevent recurrence.

Partnership with Architecture & Execution of Architectural Intent
  
  

* Implement the logical connectivity, caching strategy, DWDM design parameters, standards, and principles defined by Network Architecture & Technology Strategy.
* Provide feedback loops to Architecture on operational feasibility, automation impacts, and configuration constraints.
* Ensure all deployments align with long-range architectural direction and resiliency goals.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with Network Architecture & Technology Strategy; Carrier Services; Fiber, Fixed Wireless, and Enterprise teams; and NOC, SRE, and Service Assurance.

Financial & Investment Performance
  
  

* Own the financial and investment performance of the Network Development & Operations portfolio, including capital and operating budgets, business cases, and return-on-investment tracking.
* Drive measurable unit cost improvements (e.g., cost per bit, cost per port, cost per subscriber) through automation, standardization, and platform consolidation.
* Reduce lifecycle risk by proactively managing hardware and software end-of-life and end-of-support exposure, technical debt, and refresh roadmaps across IP, DWDM, and caching platforms.
* Partner with Finance, Architecture, and Procurement to prioritize investments, optimize vendor spend, and align spending with business outcomes.
* Report on financial, unit cost, and lifecycle-risk KPIs to senior leadership.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Possess**

* 15+ years of experience in IP engineering, DWDM engineering automation, caching platforms, or DevOps for large-scale network infrastructure.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Strong expertise in routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS), MPLS/segment routing, and routing policy.
* Hands-on experience with DWDM systems, optical telemetry, and line-system configuration.
* Experience with caching platforms (CDN nodes, edge caches, content caches).
* Experience with automation tools (Ansible, Python, CI/CD frameworks).
* Experience with telemetry, observability, and network monitoring systems.

Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to lead technical engineering teams and work across Architecture, SRE, Service Assurance, and cross-functional network teams.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate architectural intent into executable engineering workflows.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Master’s degree considered an asset, but not required.
* Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNP/CCIE, DWDM/optical certifications, cloud or DevOps certifications, Agile/Scrum certifications, SRE certifications, PMP, ITIL) are considered an asset.

Title: Network Operations Senior Advisor (Network Operations)
Description:
Job Posting Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

**Position Objective:**

The Senior Advisor serves as the principal strategic and technical sounding board to the VP of Network Operations. Orchestrating operational excellence across all network domains and drive the transition from a complex legacy infrastructure to a future-state, zero-touch architecture – targeting TM Forum Autonomous Network Level 4 (ANL 4) maturity and a modernized, unified NOC.

**Job Description & Responsibilities:**

* Act as the primary trusted advisor to the VP of Network Operations on long-term strategy, operational risk management, and technology lifecycle investments.
* Evaluate and translate emerging technological trends (e.g., 6G readiness, advanced edge computing, network slicing) into actionable, high-yield operational roadmaps.
* Advise on the governance of operational frameworks across the entirety of the operator’s footprint to ensure alignment with global standards and corporate KPIs.
* Provide strategic direction and operational efficiency oversight across eight core domains:
* Mobile Network: Next-gen RAN, vRAN, OpenRAN, and multi-generation (4G/5G/5G-Advanced) core alignment.
* Fixed Network: FTTx, GPON, and next-generation fixed access operations.
* Transport Network: IP/MPLS, Optical (DWDM), Segment Routing, and microwave backhaul optimization.
* Core & Cloud Network: Cloud-native network functions (CNFs/VNFs), telco cloud infrastructure (OpenStack, Kubernetes), and hybrid-cloud operational paradigms.
* IT Operations: Alignment of corporate IT infrastructure, workplace tech, and data center operations with network functions.
* Cybersecurity: Embedding DevSecOps into network operations, ensuring infrastructure resilience, threat mitigation, and strict regulatory compliance.
* OSS/BSS: Transforming legacy Operations and Business Support Systems into agile, microservices-driven architectures.
* AIOps Strategy Formulation: Define the overarching AI/ML roadmap for Network Operations to move toward predictive, generative, and closed-loop autonomous operations.
* AIOps Implementation: Drive the deployment of Artificial Intelligence for AI Operations (AIOps) platforms to ingest vast streams of telemetry data across Fixed, Mobile, and Cloud networks for real-time anomaly detection and predictive scaling.
* Generative AI & LLMs in Ops: Evaluate and pilot Generative AI applications (such as LLM-powered network assistants) to accelerate Tier-1/Tier-2 engineering troubleshooting, synthesize complex RCA (Root Cause Analysis) logs, and automate routine configuration scripts safely.
* Data Governance for Networks: Collaborate with Chief Data Officers/IT to establish robust data pipelines, ensuring clean, structured, and real-time network telemetry data is available to train and mature AI models.
* AI Governance & Explainability: Ensure AI/ML and closed-loop automation decisions remain auditable and explainable (XAI), preserving engineer trust and regulatory compliance as autonomy increases.
* AI Capability Upskilling: Act as a change agent to foster an AI-first mindset across the engineering workforce, advising the VP on the talent and skills gap required to operate a cognitive network.
* Lead the transformation of the NOC from siloed, domain-specific monitoring into a unified command center, consolidating EMS/NMS, service assurance, and orchestration tooling across Fixed, Mobile, Transport, Core, Cloud, and IT domains.
* Define and continuously optimize the NOC’s tiered support structure (Tier 0 automated remediation through Tier 3 specialist escalation), shifting resolution through automation, runbooks, and AI-assisted diagnostics.
* Drive AI/ML-based event correlation, event de-duplication, and noise reduction, ensuring NOC engineers focus exclusively on actionable, service-impacting events.
* Own the end-to-end Major Incident Management process, including rapid triage, cross-domain war-room coordination, executive communication, and post-incident root-cause and problem management.
* Ensure 24/7 operational resilience through effective staffing model, shift patterns, and escalation matrices that sustain continuous, around-the-clock network assurance aligned with contractual SLA commitments.
* NOC-SOC Integration: Partner with the Cybersecurity function to align NOC monitoring and incident-response workflows with Security Operations Center (SOC) processes, ensuring unified visibility into service-impacting and security-impacting events.
* Progress the NOC toward TM Forum Autonomous Network Level 4 (ANL 4) — highly autonomous, closed-loop operations — with measurable maturity targets across priority domains.
* ANL Level 4 Transition: Architect and drive the migration from manual/reactive troubleshooting to Autonomous Advanced Operations Model Level 4 (Intent-driven, highly autonomous closed-loop operations).
* Zero-Touch Self-Healing: Recommend, design, and champion AI/ML-driven initiatives to achieve predictive maintenance, automated anomaly detection, and automated root-cause analysis (RCA) to enable a self-healing infrastructure.
* OPEX Optimization: Identify structural inefficiencies across domains and execute modernization programs that significantly reduce operational costs while boosting Network Quality of Experience (QoE).
* Energy & Sustainability Optimization: Drive AI-based optimization of RAN and site power usage to cut energy cost, reduce emissions, and improve operational efficiency.
* Align all operational transformation workflows, information models, and open APIs with TM Forum Open Digital Architecture (ODA) - including eTOM, SID, and the Functional Framework to enable vendor-agnostic interoperability and support zero-touch, AI-ready operations.
* Enforce and mature the FCAPS (Fault, Configuration, Accounting, Performance, Security) model through modern, automated tooling.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or a strictly related technical field is required.
* A Master’s Degree (M.Sc. or MBA) is highly preferred
* Minimum of 20 years of progressive experience within the Telecommunications or closely related ICT sector.
* At least 5 years in a similar executive advisory capacity, or a senior management role within a Tier-1 telecom operator.
* Documented history of leading large-scale network transformation, automation, or modernization initiatives that yielded measurable OPEX savings or reliability gains.
* Deep understanding of complex network ecosystems (Fixed, Mobile, Transport, Core, IT, Cyber).
* Demonstrated experience leading or transforming a large-scale, 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC), including tiered escalation models, major incident management, and modern NOC tooling (EMS/NMS, ITSM/ticketing, alarm correlation, AIOps platforms).
* Comprehensive knowledge of TM Forum Open Digital Architecture (ODA) — including eTOM, SID, and the Functional Frameworkand traditional FCAPS infrastructure management.
* Comprehensive knowledge of AI/ML applications in telecom operations (AIOps), network virtualization (NFV/SDN), and orchestration engines.
* Industry certifications and memberships (e.g., PMP, ITIL, TOGAF, CCIE, or equivalent) are considered a plus
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to distill highly technical, fragmented architectural issues into clear, risk-managed business cases for C-suite executives and cross-functional teams.

Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
Description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Director, Information Technology Infrastructure & Services Delivery
  
  
**Business Unit / Function:**
Pr ocurement & Business Support
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
Lead infrastructure technical excellence through standards, solution design, and engineering across Maaden sites. Translate approved IT direction into reliable, scalable infrastructure and reusable capabilities. Enable IT Services Delivery to operate and support services effectively, while keeping day-to-day operations and enterprise strategy ownership with the accountable teams.
  
  
**What You Will Deliver**
Manage the infrastructure Center of Excellence for networks, systems, datacenters, and databases. Provide technical requirements, design assurance, engineering guidance and knowledge transfer, aligned with enterprise architecture and the Director’s approved priorities.
  
  
**Contract Strategy and Governance**
Develop infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps within enterprise architecture principles. Define technical specifications and acceptance criteria for infrastructure solutions and sourcing. Govern technology selection, standard configurations, and lifecycle plans, including upgrades, refresh, and retirement. Assess emerging technologies for business fit, interoperability, capacity, and supportability. Recommend designs and exceptions through established architecture authorities; enterprise policy and strategy remain with the accountable leaders .
  
  
**Contract Administration and Compliance**
Maintain design documentation, configuration baselines, and engineering procedures. Govern and oversee infrastructure projects within delegated authority, coordinating with PMO and IT Services Delivery on scope, delivery plans, milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, architecture and standards compliance, acceptance, and transition to operations. Review supplier deliverables against agreed specifications and standards. Coordinate design assurance, testing, and operational handover with IT Services Delivery, including support documentation and knowledge transfer. Verify that designs address integration, availability, capacity, recovery, and maintainability before transition. Document technical deviations and corrective actions and escalate non-compliance through the responsible governance and contract owners.
  
  
**Contractor Performance Management**
Assess suppliers’ technical deliverables and engineering quality against agreed requirements. Define and monitor infrastructure service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) in coordination with IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders; review performance against agreed targets, report deviations and drive corrective actions and continual design improvement. Use recurring-problem evidence from IT Services Delivery to inform engineering improvements. Develop infrastructure automation and DevOps engineering practices with delivery teams to improve repeatability and reduce manual work. Coach technical staff, share reusable designs and strengthen internal engineering capability. Daily operations, service support, and operational supplier SLA management remain with IT Services Delivery
  
  
**Commercial and Cost Management**
Develop capacity and lifecycle recommendations using utilization, availability, and technology requirements. Evaluate infrastructure options for standardization, reuse, and cost efficiency. Provide technical input to procurement, project estimates, and purchase requisitions within assigned responsibility; escalate funding and commercial decisions to the authorized owners. Manage and oversee infrastructure contracts, particularly the Infrastructure & Service Delivery managed service provider contract, within delegated authority and in coordination with Procurement, Legal, IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders. Validate technical scope, deliverables and SLAs/KPIs; oversee contractual compliance, performance reviews, escalations, corrective actions, changes, renewals, and exit/transition planning. Contract approvals remain with authorized signatories, and day-to-day operational ownership remains with IT Services Delivery.
  
  
**Risk, HSE and Business Continuity**
Define infrastructure resilience, backup and recovery design requirements with business continuity, security, and delivery teams. Support disaster recovery planning and testing; review technical findings and track engineering improvements. Apply relevant site HSE requirements during infrastructure work and escalate risks. Backup operations, incident response, and service restoration remain with IT Services Delivery.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Infrastructure designs meet agreed standards and business requirements; documented handovers enable effective support. Roadmaps address capacity, lifecycle, and resilience needs. Technical assurance findings are resolved, or formally escalated, recurring issues inform engineering improvements, and delivery teams can reuse documented designs and procedures. Performance targets are agreed through the established management process.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering. ITIL Foundation and ISO 20000-1 service management certification (preferred)
  
  
**Experience**
8–10 years of experience in IT service management, infrastructure, and end-user services, with practical technical requirements, infrastructure project, and standards experience. Good understanding of ITIL and ISO 20000 service management frameworks.
  
  
**Skills That Matter**
Infrastructure planning and technical documentation; analytical diagnosis and problem solving; emerging technology assessment; continuous improvement; stakeholder collaboration and communication; planning and prioritization; people leadership and capability development. Translate operational needs into clear technical specifications and explain design recommendations to technical and management audiences

Title: Technical Program Manager, Network
Description:
**About Cape**
Cape is America’s privacy-first mobile carrier. Our mission is to be a force for good in global wireless. Cape was founded in 2022 by people who believe privacy is a fundamental right, not a luxury to be traded away. Our journey began when our founder recognized a critical vulnerability in our modern world: everyone relies on the same stagnant cellular infrastructure and legacy systems that track our every movement, monitor and profile our connections, and lose and sell our personal data.
  
  
Instead of accepting the status quo, we decided to fix it. National security professionals, journalists, parents, and everyone in between can stay connected
*and*
have privacy.
  
  
We didn’t just build a layer on top of old tech; we built America’s most private and secure mobile carrier from the ground up. By building our own network from scratch, we are able to design and build a suite of privacy and security features that no other carrier on the planet can offer.
  
  
Today, Cape provides our secure network to consumers, businesses, and government agencies alike. We closed our Series C in March 2026, and we are scaling rapidly, with the goal of giving people back control of their most personal information.
  
  
**The Team**
At Cape, we are the architects of a privacy-centric movement that is just getting started. We are relentless builders, constantly innovating at the edge of what's possible in telecommunications. We operate on a foundation of high trust and high expectations. Our structure is flat, and collaboration matters more than hierarchy. As a member of our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers, architects, and visionaries, and work across organizational lines to solve "impossible" problems and deliver mission-critical results for our users every single day.
  
  
**The Role:**
Cape's network team designs how traffic actually moves through our infrastructure: routing, regional connectivity, subscriber provisioning, and the vendor-implemented changes that make it all work. Right now, that work is coordinated ad hoc, and the team needs someone to take real ownership of task tracking, timeline accountability, and communication across engineering, business development, and vendors. This role is the first of its kind in the network team. We're looking for a Program Manager who is technical enough to challenge engineering estimates, sanity-check what BD is promising customers, and set delivery timelines the team can actually hit.
  
  
You'll work in close partnership with the network operations lead to roadmap upcoming work, surface dependencies and conflicts before they become fire drills, and keep vendors accountable to what they've committed to. Telco or network experience is a plus, but we care more about startup instincts and a bias toward realistic, forward-moving plans than about a background in telecom specifically.
  
  
**What You'll Work On:**

* Own Jira hygiene and task tracking for the network team, bringing structure to work that is currently coordinated informally
* Build a reliable system for tracking work, exposing dependencies, and catching timeline slips early, across network engineering, BD, and vendors
* Partner closely with the network team's technical lead to roadmap infrastructure work like routing, regional connectivity, subscriber provisioning, and cloud/vendor integrations
* Pressure-test proposed timelines and BD requests for technical feasibility before commitments are made externally
* Host vendor meetings and hold vendors accountable to their delivery commitments
* Deconflict priorities and dependencies across the network team and adjacent teams, including consumer-facing projects
* Translate technical network work for non-technical stakeholders, and translate business requests back into realistic technical asks for engineering
* Help define the org model for how program management, technical ownership, and execution responsibilities fit together on the network team as it scales

**Experience:**

* Technical program management experience in a fast-moving engineering environment, ideally at a startup
* A track record of bringing structure to ambiguous, cross-team work without slowing it down
* Comfort learning a new technical domain quickly and deeply enough to challenge engineering judgment and assess feasibility, not just track progress
* Experience building systems for tracking work, surfacing dependencies, and holding owners accountable to deadlines
* Strong communication skills; able to translate between technical teams and business/vendor stakeholders
* Comfort engaging directly with external vendors and holding them to their commitments
* (Bonus) Experience with network or telco infrastructure: traffic routing, cloud connectivity, configuration, or subscriber provisioning
* (Bonus) Experience at a company building or operating physical/network infrastructure rather than pure software
* (Bonus) Prior experience supporting consumer products alongside more technical/infrastructure work

**Compensation:**
We offer competitive compensation that is geo-adjusted based on your location, along with meaningful equity so you share in the value you help create. Salary range for this role based in New York, NY is $190,00 - $210,000 depending on level, experience, and interview performance.
  
  
Our benefits include:
  
  

* 401(k) match
* 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents
* 12 weeks paid parental leave (for all parents, no waiting period)
* Stipends for
* Family-forming needs
* Gender-affirming care
* Unlimited PTO

**Our Culture & Values**

* We hire excellent people, give them outsized responsibility, and trust them to execute. Every person at Cape has a proven track record of tackling hard problems and winning.
* We believe that personal privacy and national security are not at odds, and that they can be reconciled through strong technology.
* We believe companies exist to build awesome things and take care of the people who build them, so we offer top-tier healthcare, 401(k) matching, and a generous vacation policy that our team actually uses to recharge.
* We believe that a stronger company and a better product are built by people from all walks of life. We hire without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. If you are great at what you do, you belong here.

Title: AI Infrastructure System Engineering - Team Lead
Description:
We are seeking a Systems Support Engineering Team Lead to support the AI server deployment process. In this role, you will be the primary operational point of contact for triaging and resolving issues during software and hardware deployment. You will monitor incoming tickets, diagnose software-related deployment bottlenecks, and collaborate with hardware and networking teams to ensure smooth deployment workflows. The ideal candidate possesses a mix of system administration, basic networking, and hardware troubleshooting knowledge, along with a strong background in Linux environments.
  
  
CIeNET Canada welcomes skilled, dedicated, innovative, and motivated professionals to join our team and build a promising career with us.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Team Management: Serve as the team lead responsible for coordinating triage operations of the daily System Support Engineering team, including prioritization and validation of issue fixes.
* Follow-the-Sun Handoff PoC: Provide a daily summary of issue triage and resolution support, with clear parameters for escalation and prioritization.
* Frontline Support: Act as the escalation point for automated deployment pipelines and installation scripts.
* Deployment Issue Triage: Monitor, investigate, and manage incoming tickets generated during the hardware and software bootstrapping phases.
* Log & Metric Analysis: Dive into installer logs, operating system metrics, and orchestration workflow histories to determine why a deployment or hardware qualification step failed including:
* Software Diagnosis: Investigate, diagnose, and resolve software-related deployment failures, containerization glitches, or configuration issues (e.g., DHCP, PXE boot, network services).
* Hardware & Firmware Escalation: Identify issues rooted in faulty hardware, outdated firmware, or physical networking constraints, and efficiently route/escalate them to the appropriate hardware engineering or data center technician teams.
* Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Update runbooks, diagnostic playbooks, and error resolution guides to streamline future deployment.
* Collaboration: Act as the bridge between software development, DevOps, and hardware operations teams to drive rapid resolution of blockers

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* Linux/OS Administration: Strong proficiency navigating, troubleshooting, and diagnosing issues in Linux environments.
* Networking Fundamentals: Good understanding of IP networking, DNS, DHCP (DHCPv4/DHCPv6), and network diagnostics.
* Hardware & Firmware Knowledge: Familiarity with server components, BMCs (Baseboard Management Controllers), BIOS, and basic physical infrastructure (NICs, switches).
* Containerization & Orchestration: Practical experience troubleshooting in Kubernetes environments (e.g., K3s, custom distributions), CNI plugins, and workload scheduling.
* Ticketing & Tracking Systems: Experience using ticket systems to manage, escalate, and organize operational tasks

**Soft Skills:**

* Team Leadership: Strong leadership and team management ability.
* PoC Management and Communication: Effective communicator and the ability to develop and maintain relationships with customer PoC's in partner engineering teams.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to distinguish between software/configuration issues and physical hardware failures.
* Incident Management: Ability to work well under time-sensitive deployment deadlines (Tier 2 response environments).
* Cross-Timezone Collaboration: Ability to pass off tasks smoothly to global counterparts at the end of a shift (handoff reporting)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bootstrap/Deployment Experience: Experience with netboot/PXE installation processes, or unattended server installation setups.
* Containerization & Orchestration: Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or workflow orchestration tools.
* Automation/Scripting: Ability to write or interpret basic scripts (Bash, Python) to assist with automated diagnostics.

Title: Senior Customer Delivery Manager
Description:
**About the role**

As a Senior Customer Delivery Manager, you will be accountable for leading the delivery of contracted Run Services for a large customer account or a portfolio of smaller accounts.

You will lead and manage teams of people, both directly and through matrix management. You’ll implement and operate an effective governance model to ensure that the services are delivered to satisfy both the Customer’s and Computacenter’s required outcomes, including but not limited to service levels, customer satisfaction and financial targets. You’ll also play a key role in the account leadership team working together to grow Computacenter’s business with the Customer.

You’ll have a role to play as a coach and mentor to other employees to ensure the continuous development of Computacenter and its people, not just as a Line Manager within your own team. You’ll also have a responsibility to engage and play a part as a senior manager in the wider organisation, working within strategic change and ongoing transformational initiatives in our Group Delivery business.

**What you’ll be doing**

* You'll be a part of the Delivery Leadership team, either in your own right or reporting through the Delivery Lead/Senior Delivery Lead to our customers.
* You'll have clear areas of accountability and will be given appropriate autonomy to lead the areas of the service that you are responsible for.
* You'll also form part of a wider community of Delivery Lead’s and will have the opportunity to actively contribute to wider in-country Delivery initiatives.

Delivery Leadership

* Lead and manage the delivery of run and change services to deliver what we’ve promised our customer and our own organization.
* Constantly drive us to do better for our customer and our own organization.
* Objectively manage performance of our internal and partner delivery teams.
* Be able to demonstrate understanding of our performance, what it means to our customer’s business, and what we’re doing to improve.
* Look to continually improve both the efficiency & effectiveness of delivery processes and services, adding value that is relevant to the customer throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Identify risks in service delivery, assess commercial implications and take measures to eliminate risk or avoid risk.

Change Delivery Management

* It’s likely that you’ll have a role leading change for our customers. Sometimes this will be relatively simple in-life service change, sometimes in supporting out Group Services colleagues it will be pulling the Computacenter organization together to deliver more complex change. In carrying out these duties, you will demonstrate awareness of relevant project management approaches.
* You’ll use your contacts and insight to identify new ways in which Computacenter can add value to our customers.

Business Leadership

* Work with the Senior Delivery Manager/Delivery Director as well as Group Services and other colleagues, as appropriate, to support the account strategy and to ensure that Computacenter presents itself as a single, joined-up team to the customer.
* Contribute to and deliver against a communications plan, both customer-facing & internal, ensuring clear & consistent messaging both verbally & in written form across various media.

Contract Management

* Support Group Services in the development, negotiation, and agreement of contract changes within the Customer account.
* Support the management of the contract schedules that relate to your scope of service. You’ll ensure compliance and manage exceptions.

Financial Management

* Manage the finances of your account or assigned services to ensure accurate forecasting and cost management to achieve or exceed financial baselines.

Relationship Management

* Work with the Delivery Lead/Snr Lead and account team to define and support the engagement strategy with the customer and other stakeholders.
* Primary interface to one or more senior stakeholders within the customer organization ensuring that you maintain a positive and constructive relationship to the benefit of both organizations.

**What you have**

* Legally eligible to work in the United States.
* You’ll be an experienced practitioner in IT Service Management.
* You’re likely trained in ITIL, possibly to Expert status.
* You’ll know that it’s not all about ITIL. You’ll be able to show that you understand how IT services fit in a customers’ business and how we as a service provider can add value.
* Perform all Line Management responsibilities for all Direct Reports. Ensure that your team, direct and virtual, is appropriately motivated and engaged and that individual performance is managed.
* Support the people strategy for the account, including capacity and succession planning, people and capability development and talent identification and retention.
* Support the communications strategy in support of the account and employee engagement strategies.
* Use coaching skills to lead and develop Services and other people within the customer account.

**What you can expect**

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.

Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. We help our world-renowned customers to source, transform, and manage their IT infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling users and their business. We’re a public company quoted on the London FTSE 250 (CCC.L) and employ over 21,000 people worldwide. In the US, we support some of the country’s best-known businesses with regional hubs in San Francisco and Irvine, CA; Norcross, GA; Plano, TX; and New York City; and Integration Centers in Silicon Valley and Atlanta. www.computacenter.com/us

Title: Incident Manager
Description:
**About Peraton**
Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.
  
  
**About The Role**
Peraton is looking for an
**Incident Manager**
to join our Team. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills, with excellent time management and attention to detail. Effective written and verbal communication skills are key, with strong critical-thinking abilities, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively as a team. These qualities are essential to successfully managing and resolving high-priority incidents in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**Work Location:**
This is a remote position with core working hours of 8am - 5pm EST
  
  
**What You Will Do:**

* Lead the coordination and management of impacting incidents to ensure timely service restoration while minimizing disruption to customers and business operations.
* Execute the enterprise Incident Management process, including monitoring incident queues, prioritizing incidents, and coordinating escalations to drive timely resolution.
* Facilitate the global response and coordination of major incidents affecting mission-critical business applications and infrastructure services in a 24/7/365 environment.
* Lead major incident communications by providing timely, accurate, and consistent updates to customers, stakeholders, and leadership throughout the incident life-cycle.
* Review and validate major incident notifications to ensure communications are complete, accurate, and appropriate for the intended audience.
* Leverage incident and problem management tools to track incidents, maintain detailed incident logs, document resolutions, and prepare reports for management review.
* Apply technical knowledge across infrastructure, applications, security, and performance management to support incident investigation and resolution.
* Collaborate with technical teams, Service Desk personnel, and other stakeholders to troubleshoot complex hardware and software issues and drive incidents toward resolution.
* Identify recurring incidents and potential trends, partnering with Problem Management teams to support root cause analysis and prevent future disruptions.
* Drive continuous improvement of the Incident Management life-cycle, including incident response procedures, escalation processes, and post-incident reviews.
* Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, operational procedures, and process guidelines for the Incident Management team.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across the organization to support critical incidents, including high-profile business events and time-sensitive operations.
* Remain composed and effective in high-pressure situations while managing competing priorities and coordinating multiple teams during critical incidents.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and provide incident management support outside of standard business hours, as needed, to ensure 24/7 service coverage.
* Maintain flexibility in work schedule to support business needs and incident response requirements.

**Problem Management**

* Engage with and assist the Problem Management team during Problem Investigations
* Utilize problem management reports to validate if any open problem known errors when handling high-priority incidents.
* Proactively and reactively, look for solutions to prevent problems from occurring in team/technology area.

**Change Management/Implementation**

* Utilize change management reports during a high-priority incident to validate if incident could be caused by change.
* Independently review, implement, and verify changes/solutions of high complexity and risk to meet customer and/or trade/IT infrastructure needs.
* May participate in a Change Advisory Board.

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Becoming a trusted advisor to the customer.

**Teamwork**

* Work as part of a team, which may be virtual, global, and/or multi-functional.
* Lead teams which address operational processes and policies in work area.
* Seen as a resource to the team in one or more technical or business areas.
* Becoming a trusted advisor inside and outside the team/technology area.

**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance
* Must be willing to undergo a pre-employment credit check as required by the Customer.
* Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of experience, a Master's Degree and 3 years of experience, an Associate's Degree and 7 years of experience, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years of experience
* 3+ years of relevant experience in Customer Service, Incident Management, or general project management
* Familiarity and understanding of IT Service Management tools (Remedy, JIRA, ServiceNow, etc.)
* Working knowledge of the technology, applications, and infrastructure within areas of responsibility
* Ability to effectively coordinate technical teams during incident investigation and resolution
* Developing and maintaining relationships with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication, collaboration, and coordination throughout the incident management life-cycle
* Proficiency with MS Office: Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* ITIL Foundations Certification
* One or more of the following Incident Response related certifications: Threat Handling Foundations certificate, Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), Practical SOC Analyst Associate (PSAA), OffSec Incident Responder (OSIR), or Certified Incident Handler (ECIH)

**Details**
Target Salary Range: $51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.
  
  
Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

Title: Service Delivery Lead
Description:

**Job Type: Direct Hire**

**Location: Frisco, TX 75034 (Onsite)**

**Job Overview**

One of our clients is seeking an experienced PAM Service Delivery Lead / Senior PAM SRE Operations Manager to lead the operational delivery of a 24/7 Privileged Access Management (PAM) Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) service within a large, regulated financial services environment.

This role will be responsible for managing end-to-end service delivery, 24/7 production support, SLA performance, major incident management, operational governance, vendor relationships, and team development across a specialized PAM technology ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be a senior IT infrastructure operations leader with strong experience managing 24/7 SRE or production support teams, SLA-backed managed services, and working knowledge of PAM technologies such as CyberArk and Conjur.

* Lead day-to-day operational delivery of the 24/7 PAM SRE service across Conjur, CCP/CP, Synchronizer, CyberArk SaaS integrations, and BoKS.
* Manage follow-the-sun support operations, including shift coverage, weekends, holidays, PTO backfill, and critical coverage requirements.
* Monitor and report P0/P1 incident response and resolution SLAs, operational performance, incident trends, and automation progress.
* Conduct weekly operational reviews and monthly service reviews with stakeholders.
* Act as the primary escalation point for vendor teams and participate in client-facing major incident bridges.
* Lead P0/P1 incident management, ensuring timely resolution, effective communication, and executive-level updates.
* Drive root cause analysis (RCA), problem management, and corrective actions to prevent recurring incidents.
* Oversee change management, patching, and upgrade schedules in coordination with client change management teams.
* Lead knowledge transfer, shadowing, service transitions, and transition-to-full-ownership activities.
* Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and audit/compliance documentation.
* Ensure operational readiness, service continuity, access governance, and compliance with established policies.
* Coach, mentor, and develop SRE team members while managing attrition, resource planning, and bench risk.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, vendors, and internal technology stakeholders.
* Ensure consistent service quality, SLA compliance, and operational excellence across all shifts.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in IT infrastructure operations.
* 5+ years of experience leading 24/7 production support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or infrastructure operations teams.
* Proven experience managing SLA-backed managed services within regulated environments.
* Strong understanding of incident, problem, and change management processes.
* ITIL v4 certification or equivalent ITIL service management experience.
* Experience with ServiceNow or similar IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms.
* Working knowledge of Privileged Access Management (PAM) and secrets management technologies, including CyberArk, Conjur, or similar platforms.
* Demonstrated experience leading major incident bridges and managing critical P0/P1 escalations.
* Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and executive stakeholders during critical incidents.
* Strong vendor management, client relationship management, and service delivery experience.
* Excellent written, verbal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Willingness and ability to support 24/7 operations, including weekends and holidays.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) environments.
* CyberArk Defender, CyberArk Sentry, or equivalent PAM certifications.
* Experience managing large-scale Unix/Linux environments (1,000+ hosts).
* Experience with BoKS or similar privileged access management tools.
* Knowledge of Disaster Recovery (DR) planning, testing, and operational game-day exercises.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability platforms such as Splunk, Datadog, and Dynatrace.
* Understanding of regulatory and audit frameworks such as SOX, FFIEC, or similar compliance standards.

Title: Cloud Software Manager
Description:
**Job Description**
**About Us**
Dyson is a global technology company that transforms every category it enters where we aim to continue our reputation of being innovative and disruptive. Since our first launch of products in connected space, we have grown fast to several millions of connected machines. As we look toward 2026 and beyond, we are anticipating exponential growth in scale and functionality.
  
  
We want to build reliable, scalable, and secure services and features to support these increasing demands globally with innovative and competitive technologies in IoT, Machine Data Lake, Data Analytics and AI to support our vision.
  
  
We have a ‘You build it, you run it’ ethos and run all our services within Amazon Web Services (AWS). Our teams are responsible for the architecture, development, testing, and operational support of their services in all environments. We are a global department with teams located in the UK, Singapore, and China and we encourage flexible, independent, and innovative thinking in our engineers to deliver solutions. We are now expanding this mission to Dubai based on Build-Operate-Transfer(BOT) model.
  
  
If you thrive on working in a collaborative, stimulating, dynamic environment and relish difficult software engineering challenges then we’d like to speak to you!
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Engineering Manager (Cloud), you will assist in building and leading a Cloud team in Dubai under a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model. Alongside providing strategic leadership and technical mentorship, you will remain hands-on—directly contributing to technical deliverables to ensure the team meets its milestones. You will also work closely with our existing teams in Singapore and China to ensure seamless integration across regions
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

The Technical Program Manager administers the qualification and validation of new products, and of retrofits and engineering changes to existing parts, for use in large-scale data center environments. **What You’ll Do:**

* **Validation Program Planning and Execution:** Develop and own integrated validation program plans covering both new product introduction and retrofits or engineering changes to existing parts — qualification sequence, entry and exit criteria, material and laboratory dependencies, and decision gates — holding the critical path and driving programs to documented closure.
* **Inside Plant and Outside Plant Infrastructure:** Manage ISP structured cabling across backbone and horizontal distribution, riser and plenum pathways, main and intermediate distribution frames (MDF/IDF), cabinet and rack-mounted patch fields, fiber distribution frames, splice and termination enclosures, cassette-based modular patching, cable tray, basket and innerduct pathway, and firestopping and pathway segregation; and OSP placement across duct bank and conduit, microduct and air-blown fiber, maintenance holes and handholes, aerial and direct-buried routes, building entrance facilities and points of entry (MPOE), transition splice points, armored and dielectric constructions, and environmental and ingress protection at the ISP/OSP demarcation.
* **Fiber Cable, Connectivity, and Termination Scope:** Qualify single-mode (OS2, 9/125 µm) and multimode cable across the full range of standard counts in general industry use, from 24-fiber distribution cable through 3456-fiber high-count backbone, in loose tube, central core, ribbon, rollable ribbon, and 200/250 µm coating designs, evaluating diameter, bend radius, pulling tension, duct fill, and mid-span access against pathway and installation constraints. Own connectivity across LC and LC duplex, MTP/MPO single-row and dual-row arrays (8, 12, 16, and 24 fiber), and very-high-density MMC arrays (16 and 24 fiber), including pinned (male) and unpinned (female) configurations, UPC and APC endface geometries, gender and key orientation, and polarity schemes spanning TIA-568 Method A, B, and C and the conventions applicable to multi-row arrays. Define and validate patch panel, cassette, adapter plate, and shelf configurations for port density, fiber management, bend radius protection, slack storage, labeling access, and serviceability, and evaluate breakout, fanout, harness, trunk, and pigtail assemblies against port mapping and channel performance requirements.
* **Test, Measurement, and Acceptance:** Establish and govern optical test programs — Tier 1 optical loss test set (OLTS) insertion loss and return loss certification, Tier 2 OTDR characterization, bidirectional testing, length and continuity verification, polarity and fitment verification, and endface inspection and cleaning to recognized criteria such as IEC 61300-3-35 — controlling test reference cord (TRC) grade, referencing method, and calibration state so results are repeatable and defensible. Reconcile measured channel performance against design acceptance criteria and transceiver link specifications, and drive corrective action where acceptance limits are not met.
* **Supplier Qualification and Test Equipment Capability:** Lead technical qualification of cable, connectivity, and pathway manufacturers through sample submission, first-article inspection, mechanical and optical evaluation, failure analysis, root cause determination, and corrective action closure, maintaining a defensible qualification record and a clear statement of remaining gaps per supplier. Evaluate, select, and introduce fiber test and inspection platforms end to end, covering technical evaluation against requirements, procurement support, asset control and inventory, calibration and reference cord management, operator training, and fleet distribution to regional field crews.
* **Documentation and Standards:** Produce and sustain installation work instructions, test procedures, golden samples, first-of-kind build documentation, labeling and administration schemes, and as-built records, maintaining them so methods are applied consistently by field crews and subcontractors without procedural drift.
* **Program Governance and Risk Management:** Maintain accurate program status, ownership, target dates, and documented reasons for schedule movement, and produce recurring technical status reporting for client and internal leadership, surfacing aging, blocked, and unassigned work rather than allowing it to persist. Identify technical, schedule, supply chain, and capability risks in advance, quantify impact, drive mitigation to a named owner and committed date, and escalate with a recommendation.
* **Safety and Regulatory Compliance:** Champion a zero-injury culture in laboratory and field environments, ensuring personnel and subcontractors understand and apply laser safety, confined space, excavation, aerial work, and fiber handling requirements, and that work complies with OSHA and other applicable regulations and site access requirements.

Title: Manager, Service Management
Description:
**OUR COMPANY BACKGROUND & CULTURE**

  

UPP is the first pension plan of its kind in Ontario’s university sector, proudly serving over 46,000 members across six universities and nineteen sector organizations. Our purpose is to bring greater retirement peace of mind to the university sector by investing with integrity and serving members with care. As a sector-wide plan designed for growth, our doors are open to all Ontario universities. 

  

We’re a team of progressive thinkers and agile doers operating within a fast-paced culture of collaboration and respect. We believe in bringing smart and capable people together to create, solve, and grow with a clear shared vision and values of integrity, inclusivity, ingenuity, and impact.

  

We’ve built and nurtured a culture that is intentionally welcoming and purposefully rooted in equity, diversity, inclusion, and reconciliation (EDI&R). We believe diverse teams, perspectives, and lived experiences contribute to better decisions and a better workplace. As UPP celebrates its fifth anniversary, we’re proud to be recognized for our efforts:

  

  
* 2026 Greater Toronto’s Top 100 Employers
  
* 2026 Canadian HR Award for Excellence in Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging
  

  

Join us in building a bright future for our members, our organization, and each other.

**THE ROLE**

  

We are seeking a proactive and outcomes-focused Manager, Service Management to oversee the performance, governance, and continuous improvement of our Managed Service Provider (MSP) and service management practice.  This position plays a critical role in overseeing the performance and governance of our Managed Service Provider (MSP), ensuring the delivery of resilient and reliable IT services including O365, workloads hosted on Google Cloud Platform, third-party cloud systems, infrastructure, and execution of core ITIL processes.

  

Reporting directly to the Director, Technology & Security Operations, the Manager will lead service governance, major incident coordination, and process improvement initiatives across ITIL disciplines, while also supporting technology continuity planning and operational readiness.

  

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced service management professional to join a team of high-performing individuals and make a great impact in a fast-paced organization.  

  

This role is based in downtown Toronto in a hybrid work environment, allowing employees the flexibility to work remotely and in-office (minimum two days per week in-office).

  

This posting is for a existing vacancy.

  

**SPECIFIC ACCOUNTABILITIES**

  

The Manager, Service Management will be responsible for a variety of duties, including but not limited to the following:

  

  
* Manage MSP performance against agreed service levels, KPIs, financial measures and contractual commitments, addressing gaps that could affect service quality, cost or user experience.
  
* Turn service data into business insight by reporting on availability, response and resolution times, ticket quality and other key measures to support leadership decisions.
  
* Drive performance improvement by reviewing MSP reports, identifying service risks and trends, and agreeing and tracking corrective actions.
  
* Govern core service management practices across Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset and Technology Continuity Management to improve consistency, accountability and service outcomes.
  
* Lead the response to P1 and P2 incidents as Incident Manager, coordinating response teams, managing escalations and keeping stakeholders informed until services are restored.
  
* Maintain effective escalation arrangements by keeping system contact paths current and ensuring the MSP follows clear escalation procedures and role assignments for critical incidents.
  
* Strengthen post-incident outcomes by facilitating reviews, validating root cause analyses and tracking actions that reduce the risk of recurrence.
  
* Review and approve changes through the CAB by confirming business readiness, risk controls and alignment with service and operational requirements.
  
* Keep operational procedures current and usable so internal teams and service partners can follow consistent, approved ways of working.
  
* Support technology continuity and recovery by helping maintain, test and improve disaster recovery plans to protect critical business services.
  
* Use service trends to identify improvement opportunities and lead initiatives with internal teams and the MSP that improve reliability, efficiency and user experience.
  
* Build strong working relationships across the organization to align service delivery with business expectations, operational priorities and user needs.
  

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

  

  
* 10+ years of experience in IT service management, preferably within hybrid or federated delivery models.
  
* 5+ years managing an IT Managed Service Provider, including setting clear expectations, monitoring performance against contracts and service levels, resolving delivery gaps, and driving accountability for results.
  
* Strong knowledge of ITIL 4 and a track record of improving service management practices to strengthen reliability, efficiency and the user experience.
  
* Experience leading innovation and continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to use automation, monitoring and service data to improve outcomes and reduce recurring effort.
  
* Demonstrated ability to lead major incidents, coordinating distributed teams and vendors, communicating clearly with stakeholders, and driving timely service restoration.
  
* Experience advancing ServiceNow capabilities for service workflows, dashboards, monitoring, ticket management and performance reporting.
  
* Experience supporting disaster recovery exercises, coordinating the collection and validation of system evidence and tracking follow-up actions.
  
* Strong planning and estimation skills, including assessing initiative scope, dependencies, effort and timelines, and communicating delivery expectations.
  
* Excellent documentation and communication skills, including the ability to present service performance, risks and improvement plans to senior stakeholders.
  
* Experience working across business units to build understanding, adoption and consistent use of operational processes.
  
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher certification; familiarity with ISO 27001, NIST or COBIT frameworks.
  

  

**ATTRIBUTES**

  

  
* Takes initiative, follows through reliably and works independently while keeping stakeholders informed.
  
* Communicates clearly and effectively with business leaders, technical teams and service providers.
  
* Builds practical, repeatable processes that improve service consistency and accountability.
  
* Organizes and aligns contributions from multiple teams to deliver agreed outcomes.
  
* Anticipates issues, investigates root causes and takes action to resolve them.
  
* Uses data and sound judgment to assess performance, identify risks and guide decisions.
  
* Combines a hands-on approach with the ability to set clear expectations and hold the MSP accountable for results.
  
* Looks for opportunities to innovate and continuously improve service quality, efficiency and user experience.
  
* Monitors relevant technologies, trends, threats, standards and products, and recommends changes that strengthen the organization’s security posture and support business needs.
  

**EXPECTED COMPENSATION**

  
  

The expected compensation for this role is a combination of base salary and variable incentive.

  

The annualized base salary in the range of
**$85,600**
to
**$135,600**
. This range reflects the expected range for new hire base salaries and is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

  

You may also be eligible for a variable incentive depending on organizational, divisional and personal performance. The final total compensation offered will vary depending on your skills, experience and other factors.

  

**LIFE AT UPP**

  

**Do work that matters.**
We are duty-bound to serve our members’ interests, and it’s a responsibility we don’t take lightly. That’s why we’ve ingrained sustainability in our work from day one—to ensure our members have a resilient future to retire into, both today and for generations to come.

  

**Stronger together.**
Collaboration is how UPP was born, and it’s how we work with each other and our partners day in, day out. No one at UPP is just a number (even if they are excellent at math) and every win is a shared win.

  

**Grow every day.**
You’ll have the opportunity to work on unique, once-in-a-career projects that maximize your skill set and probably teach you some new ones—at any stage in your career.

  

**Prioritize wellness.**
At UPP, wellness takes many forms. Ultimately, it’s about ensuring our people are cared for in the ways that matter to them. Check out some highlights of our inclusive employee-focused benefits program including:

  

  
* Defined benefit pension plan
  
* Flexible hybrid work model

* Extended paramedical and mental health service coverage

* Fertility treatments, paid parental leave, and gender affirmation coverage
  
* Education Assistance program

**Position Summary:**

Reporting directly to the President, the Director maintains comprehensive accountability for technical service delivery, engineering, security operations, project execution, personnel management, and customer satisfaction. The Director provides leadership and operational oversight of the company's security-focused managed services and compliance services practices, including services aligned with the CIS Controls, NIST SP 800-171, and CMMC requirements. This responsibility requires demonstrated experience managing technical service organizations operating under established cybersecurity frameworks, contractual security requirements, and formal compliance obligations.

As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the Director contributes to corporate strategy, organizational development, service portfolio maturity, and continuous operational improvement. The position requires substantial MSP leadership experience, strong technical and financial judgment, effective customer and situational management skills, and a demonstrated ability to develop personnel and improve organizational performance through measurable outcomes.

* Direct technical standards, service management procedures, change management, documentation quality, and operational process improvements.

* Conduct recurring management reviews of service quality, customer concerns, backlogs, operational risks, project margins, and corrective actions; analyze findings and implement necessary improvements.

* Minimum 10 years of progressive professional experience in information technology, technical services, or technical operations.
* Minimum three (3) years managing departmental personnel and technical service delivery operations within a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment.
* Demonstrated experience as an MSP operations director, service delivery director, or comparable senior technical operations leader.
* Experience owning departmental budgets, utilization, project margins, financial reporting, and measurable operational performance.
* Experience directing multidisciplinary teams across service desk, engineering, systems administration, security operations, and project delivery.
* Direct experience conducting recurring customer project meetings and managing critical technical escalations with executive stakeholders, including delivery of cybersecurity-focused managed services.

* ISO/IEC 20000-1 or ISO/IEC 27001 training, audit, implementation, or professional certification.
* Experience operating cybersecurity-focused managed services and compliance services practices in regulated environments, including CIS Controls, CMMC, or NIST SP 800-171.
* CMMC Registered Practitioner (RP) credential or higher-level CMMC professional certification.
* Relevant Microsoft, virtualization, networking, or cybersecurity professional certifications.
* Demonstrated results implementing measurable process improvement, automation, team development, and organizational change.

**Essential Duties:**

2. Project Delivery and Customer Project Management – 20%

3. Departmental Personnel Leadership and Professional Development – 15%

4. Financial Management, Budgeting, and Reporting – 15%

5. Service Platforms, Process Improvement, and Technical Standards – 10%

7. Maintain current service procedures, assigned technical standards, and platform ownership records; review, revise as necessary, sign, implement, and enforce assigned policies and procedures within established review cycles; and document implemented process improvements and measurable outcomes.
